items.title: 4 Dividend Kings Paying the Highest Yields Today
items.summary: Fifty years of dividend raises sounds bulletproof, yet several former Kings broke their streaks. We checked earnings and cash flow behind four of the highest yielders, and one payout looks far shakier than the rest.

items.title: 3 Dividend Aristocrats Yielding More Than the 2027 COLA
items.summary: Social Security just promised retirees a raise, but three blue-chip payers have been handing out bigger starting checks and annual bumps for decades. One pays monthly, one holds a record no other REIT can touch, and one carries a warning sign.

items.title: REG Q3 FFO & Revenues Beat Estimates on NOI Growth, '26 View Raised
items.summary: Regency Centers beats Q3 FFO and revenue estimates as strong leasing spreads, rising occupancy and higher same-property NOI drive growth and boost its 2026 outlook.

items.title: SPG Q3 FFO Tops Estimates on Leasing Strength, Outlook Raised
items.summary: Simon Property Group beats Q3 FFO and revenue estimates as higher rents, strong retailer sales and leasing momentum drive growth, prompting an increase in 2026 guidance.

items.title: O Q3 FFO Beats Estimates on Higher Revenues & Active Investments
items.summary: Realty Income's Q3 AFFO and revenues top estimates as higher rental income and credit investments drive growth, prompting management to raise its 2026 outlook.

items.title: What FT Vest Dividend Aristocrats Target Income (KNG) Bought: C.H. Robinson Leads on Oct. 30
items.summary: The fund bought $14.3 million of C.H. Robinson and sold $13.8 million of FactSet, with $317.7 million in gross trading against $3.46 billion in assets.

items.title: What's in the Cards for Simon Property This Earnings Season?
items.summary: SPG's Q3 2026 earnings are expected to reflect higher revenues and FFO per share, fueled by strong leasing demand despite rising interest expenses.

items.title: Federal Realty: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Signed leases worth 270 basis points of future rent are already locked in, setting up built-in revenue growth for next year.
